items.title: Regional Sales Summary & Ranking
items.description: Aggregate revenue by region with SUMIFS, sort descending, and format currency.
items.prompt: Summarize total sales by region in E1:F5 using SUMIFS, sort the summary descending by revenue, and format amounts as currency.

items.title: Gross Margin Error Audit & Repair
items.description: Locate #DIV/0! errors via list_errors precedent chains and wrap with IFERROR.
items.prompt: Audit all formula errors in the gross margin table and guard zero-revenue rows so margins evaluate cleanly.

items.title: Dynamic Array Top-5 Customers
items.description: Build a dynamic SORT/TAKE spill dashboard and sum with the # spill operator.
items.prompt: Create a dynamic Top-3 customer leaderboard in D2 using SORT and TAKE, and compute the combined total in E6 using the spill operator D2#.

items.title: Budget Variance & Q1 Subtotal Row
items.description: Insert a Q1 subtotal row with identity-anchored references and compute variance %.
items.prompt: Insert a Q1 Subtotal row after March (row 4), calculate Budget/Actual subtotals, and add Variance % in column D.

items.title: Cross-Sheet XLOOKUP Price Join
items.description: Join unit prices from a Catalog sheet into Orders via XLOOKUP and fill line totals.
items.prompt: Add a Catalog price lookup in Orders!C2:C4 using XLOOKUP and compute Line Total in D2:D4.

items.title: Named Range NPV & IRR Cashflow Model
items.description: Define DiscountRate named range and compute project NPV and IRR.
items.prompt: Define a workbook named range DiscountRate pointing to B1 (8%), then calculate NPV in B7 and IRR in B8.

items.title: Messy Customer Name Cleanup
items.description: Normalize whitespace and casing with TRIM/PROPER and extract domains with TEXTSPLIT.
items.prompt: Clean customer names into C2:C4 with PROPER(TRIM(...)) and build formatted contact tags in D2:D4 with TEXTJOIN.

items.title: Workday SLA Due Date & Status
items.description: Compute business-day SLA due dates with WORKDAY and classify overdue tickets via IFS.
items.prompt: Compute 5-business-day SLA due dates in D2:D4 using WORKDAY and classify status vs Closed Date in E2:E4 using IFS.

items.title: Quarterly Multi-Key Sort & Percentile Rank
items.description: Sort reps by Region then Score descending, then add RANK.EQ and PERCENTILE.INC.
items.prompt: Sort A1:C6 by Region ascending then Score descending, add RANK.EQ in D2:D6, and show the 80th percentile threshold in C8.

items.title: Interactive Conflict & Reference Closure Lab
items.description: Hands-on walkthrough with a concurrent main-branch cell conflict and an inserted-row reference closure check.
items.prompt: Insert a Tax Adjustment row at row 2, update Q1 Forecast (B3) to 520, and reference the new Tax row from Net Total (C1).
